expect:
Calculation:
MA = 80 ÷ 20 = 4 [2 marks: 1 formula, 1 correct answer]
Evaluation:
• MA of 4 means the user applies four times less force than the cutting force, which reduces the effort needed — suitable for most users but may still require significant grip strength. [2 marks]
• A person with reduced grip strength may still struggle if the friction from the can rim or dull blade adds resistance not captured in the MA calculation alone. [2 marks]
• The handle diameter and texture also affect comfort — a thin hard handle concentrates force on the palm, increasing discomfort. [1 mark]
Modification:
• Increase the effort arm to, e.g., 160 mm — doubling it to give MA = 8, halving the required effort. [1 mark]
• OR fit a soft ergonomic grip to spread contact force across a wider palm area. [1 mark]
• OR add a ratchet mechanism so continuous rotation is not required, reducing peak grip force. [1 mark]
[10 marks — Mastering: Correct calculation, sustained evaluation addressing suitability and limitations with quantified evidence, specific justified modification. Secure: Correct calculation, basic suitability evaluation, modification stated. Developing: Partial calculation or evaluation without modification. Emerging: Attempt at calculation only.]
